correctness.rationale: Homogeneous 4x4 moment-curve determinant is the six-factor Vandermonde product. Sliding the extreme indices to 0 and N strictly increases it; x+y+z=N reduces the product to Ny*xz*(xz+Ny). For fixed y the balanced product xz is uniquely maximized up to reversal, yielding exactly H_N(y). The exact discrete difference has positive factor N²-(y+delta)² and sign N²-T_N(y), with increasing parity-sensitive T; positivity through q-1 and negativity from q+1 give only two candidates. Equality gives Lucas/Fibonacci Pell equation u²-5N²=-4, completed by positive integer descent. Separately convex determinant in each tetrahedral corner extends the maximum from vertex corners to arbitrary body corners, without classifying nonvertex equality. Independently brute-enumerated ALL C(N+1,4) quadruples for every N=3..60; every winner and tie agreed with two-candidate/Pell theorem. Finite checks support algebra but the sign argument and descent supply all-N proof.
